content.text:
The drawing shows a central quaternary carbon bonded to four CH2 groups. Each CH2 is attached to an oxygen, and each oxygen is attached to a nitro group drawn as N+(=O)O-. This is pentaerythritol tetranitrate (PETN).

SMILES: [O-][N+](=O)OCC(CO[N+](=O)[O-])(CO[N+](=O)[O-])CO[N+](=O)[O-]
